verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a dashboard of income, expenses and VAT liability, a trial balance, a BWA report and a cash-basis income statement. None of these is described as an accounts-payable aging report or as per-vendor balances as of a chosen date. The trial balance and receipt-to-payment matching are adjacent features, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
